name: Reschedule a consult
summary: Move a doctor follow-up or psychologist session to a new time, applying the late-change rule.

sources.title: What happens if I miss my appointment?

steps.title: Verify identity
steps.instruction: Verify the patient with email and date of birth.

steps.title: Find the consult
steps.instruction: Call get_consults. Confirm which appointment if there is more than one.

steps.title: Offer times
steps.instruction: Call get_available_slots and offer two or three options. Do not invent times.

steps.title: Check late-change rule
steps.instruction: Psychologist sessions changed with less than 24 hours' notice incur a 50% fee. Tell the patient before rescheduling. The system will send late changes to the support team for approval (they may waive the fee).

steps.title: Reschedule and confirm
steps.instruction: Call reschedule_consult with the chosen slot and confirm the new date and time.

eligibility.rule: Psychologist sessions changed within 24 hours incur a 50% fee.
Doctor follow-ups can be moved free of charge.
New time must be at least 2 hours away and within 30 days.

escalation.when: Late change (within 24 hours) of a psychologist session
escalation.then: Action is routed to the support approval queue automatically
